title: 第十二届校园电影节正式启幕
titleEn: The 12th Campus Film Festival Officially Opens
summary: 以“合心众响”为主题的第十二届校园电影节正式拉开帷幕。本届影节聚焦校园创作者的影像表达，寻找属于这一代人的时代共振。
summaryEn: The 12th Campus Film Festival has officially opened under the theme Resonance. This year’s edition spotlights student filmmakers and the distinct image-making voices of a new generation.

title: 评审团阵容公布
summary: 本届影节邀请来自导演、编剧、制片、媒体策划与后期创作领域的嘉宾组成评审团，为参赛作品提供专业评审与指导。
summaryEn: This year’s jury brings together guests from directing, screenwriting, producing, media strategy and post-production to provide professional feedback and evaluation for submitted works.

title: 投稿通道正式开放
summary: 各学段投稿通道现已开放，投稿截止时间为 2026 年 3 月 25 日 23:59。请按要求提交作品，并留意技术规格与字幕要求。
summaryEn: Submissions are now open across all divisions. The final deadline is March 25, 2026 at 23:59. Please review the technical specifications and subtitle requirements before uploading your work.

title: 幕后手记：如何拍好一部校园短片
titleEn: Behind the Scenes: How to Make a Strong Campus Short
summary: 从选题构思到后期剪辑，组委会整理了一份实用创作指南，帮助同学们在有限时间内完成更成熟的影像表达。
summaryEn: From concept development to final edit, the committee has prepared a practical guide to help students build stronger, more focused films within a limited production window.

title: 影节视觉周边设计揭晓
summary: 本届影节主视觉由心形与声波交织构成，象征“合心”与“众响”的交融。相关海报与纪念物料将陆续发布。
summaryEn: The festival’s visual identity combines heart motifs and sound waves to echo the idea of collective resonance. Posters and commemorative materials will be released in stages.
